name: Tubal
overview: Tubal is identified in Scripture as one of the sons of Japheth, marking the origin of a distinct people group or nation (Genesis 10:2; 1 Chronicles 1:5). This nation is recognized among other Gentile peoples who interacted in trade and warfare, as seen in Ezekiel's references to Tubal's commercial activity and military presence (Ezekiel 27:13; 32:26). Furthermore, Tubal is included in prophetic declarations concerning the spread of God's glory to distant nations and in eschatological warnings involving allied powers (Isaiah 66:19; Ezekiel 38:2). These passages collectively affirm Tubal's role as a significant Gentile nation within God's sovereign plan for history.
